@graph.name: SYJ Mining Platform
@graph.description: An engineering-focused mining software project emphasizing controlled execution, benchmark verification, hardware telemetry, artifact integrity, and evidence-driven qualification.

acceptedAnswer.text: SYJ Mining Platform is an engineering-focused mining software project developed by SAYANJALI NEXUS PRIVATE LIMITED. It emphasizes controlled execution, benchmark verification, hardware telemetry, artifact integrity, and evidence-driven qualification rather than speculative performance claims.
RandomX is a proof-of-work algorithm designed for general-purpose CPUs. It is the current mining execution path under engineering evaluation within SYJ Mining Platform.

mainEntity.name: Is SYJ Mining Platform open source?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project's source is developed in the open at github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-Mining. Formal licensing terms will be published in the repository; check the repository directly for the current license file before assuming reuse rights.

mainEntity.name: What hardware does SYJ Mining Platform support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hardware and operating system support is not yet publicly verified. The current qualification harness targets general-purpose CPU execution; specific supported configurations will be published once confirmed.

mainEntity.name: How does SYJ Mining Platform verify benchmark integrity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every qualification run performs pre-run and post-run SHA-256 verification of the execution artifact, alongside timestamped telemetry and raw stdout/stderr capture, so results can be traced back to a known, unmodified binary.

mainEntity.name: Does measurement qualification automatically enable mining?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Measurement qualification is intentionally separated from economic and execution authorization. A qualified benchmark does not by itself set economics_authorized or execution_enabled to true.

mainEntity.name: Does SYJ Mining Platform guarantee profitability?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The project does not claim or guarantee mining profitability. Its scope is measurement, verification, and qualification methodology, not financial return.
